articles.title: Bitcion tumbles to $76,000 as collapsing AI trade drags stocks sharply lower
articles.snippet: The post-election rally quickly reversed as AI stocks plunged, but cryptocurrencies held up relatively better despite a $1 billion liquidation wave.

articles.title: Google could take stake in bitcoin miner TeraWulf’s $19 billion AI project if Anthropic defaults
articles.snippet: A $19 billion data-center agreement includes an unusual provision allowing Google to acquire part of the project if Anthropic fails to pay its rent.

articles.title: Bitcoin is resilient, but leverage is missing and demand still tepid
Bitcoin miner Riot could pay Anthropic 12% interest under $28 billion AI deal
articles.snippet: Riot has sold most of its bitcoin to fund its move into data centers. Its latest agreement gives Anthropic a way to finance part of the build and collect interest through rent deductions.

articles.title: The pile of lawsuits against Kalshi just grew by one
articles.snippet: Arkansas has accused the prediction market of running illegal gambling, joining Utah and several other U.S. states that have filed criminal or civil charges.
